name: antigravity-credit-resumer
description: Automatically resumes Antigravity AI Cascades when credits refill and manages model switching settings.

antigravityCreditResumer.modelSelectionM.markdownDescription:
Configure model selection behavior when credits run out.
- `stick`: Keep the user-selected model and wait for its credits to refresh.
- `auto`: Automatically cycle through available models with positive credit quota.

antigravityCreditResumer.resumePrompt.description: The prompt string to submit to the active cascade when resuming (e.g. 'continue' or 'resume').

antigravityCreditResumer.checkInterval.description: Frequency (in seconds) to check credit status.

antigravityCreditResumer.debugLogging.description: Enable detailed debug logging to the 'Antigravity Credit Resumer (Debug)' channel.

antigravityCreditResumer.showStatusBar.description: Show credit status indicator in the bottom status bar.

antigravityCreditResumer.showNotificatio.description: Show toast notifications when the resumer auto-continues active cascades or switches models.

antigravityCreditResumer.persistentLoggi.description: Enable persistent logging and history files inside the active workspace under `.logs/`.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
